comment: Bot-free live rocket jump on Larak Lot from the first spawn slot (TOLL north): take the Rocket from the bottom of the Pit, climb back out by the Toll Steps and the Spiral to the Gallery, and jump the 1.5 m onto the Roof with a rocket fired at the floor, then look at the Custody Plate. Ordinary input through the server. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1 and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/rocket-jump.json.

states.name: rocket_pad
states.note: The Rocket at the bottom of the Pit, in the lee of the Stack, from the Lane lip by the Toll Steps.

states.name: pit_rocket
states.note: Taken by walking onto its pad: the Pistol start finds the launcher.

states.name: gallery_ledge
states.note: The Gallery's east edge: the Roof sits 1.5 m up, out of a jump's reach.

states.name: rocket_jump
states.note: Run, jump, and fire straight down on the next tick: the push lifts the fighter onto the Roof.

states.name: roof_plate
states.note: The Custody Plate in the valet circle under the LARAK sign, as the fighter who just came up sees it.
